context_excerpt: 2023-11-10 **Event**: Platform X officially launched a creator rewards program on November 9, 2023, replacing the original creator fund and creativity program beta. The new program ties earnings to four major dimensions: watch time, engagement behavior, search value, and ad value. For original videos longer than 1 minute, creators can earn higher rewards if the videos have longer playback time, higher completion rate…
